cases.sentence: Люди увидели, что сделал Павел, и стали кричать на ___:
cases.explain: «ликаонском языке» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”

cases.sentence: За городом был храм Зевса, и его жрец привел к ___ быков и принес венки; желая вместе с народом принести им жертву.
cases.explain: «городским воротам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

cases.sentence: На ___ они с Варнавой ушли в Дервию.
cases.explain: «следующий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.
